<thought>Based on the observed monoisotopic [M+H]+ peak at m/z 193.1103, the neutral mass is ≈192.103 Da. The formula C₈H₁₆O₅ gives a calculated [M+H]+ of 193.1071 Da, matching the measured value within a few millidaltons, and is the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
